title: Advanced Reported Speech: Nuanced Reporting Verbs
group: B1.3 - Critical Perspectives & Bridge to B2
objective: Menggantikan 'say' dan 'tell' dengan kata kerja pelapor presisi seperti admit, warn, advise, remind, apologize, dan refuse.

theory.summary: Dalam reported speech tingkat lanjut, kita menggunakan reporting verbs yang lebih spesifik untuk menyampaikan nuansa dan maksud pembicara dengan lebih akurat. Alih-alih hanya menggunakan 'say' atau 'tell', kita bisa menggunakan kata kerja seperti admit (mengakui), warn (memperingatkan), advise (menasihati), remind (mengingatkan), apologize (meminta maaf), refuse (menolak), offer (menawarkan), dan promise (berjanji). Setiap reporting verb memiliki pola gramatikal tersendiri yang harus diikuti.
rules: Verb + to-infinitive: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti offer, promise, refuse, threaten, agree. Contoh: He offered to help me. | She refused to answer the question. | They agreed to meet at 5 PM.

Verb + object + to-infinitive: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti warn, advise, remind, encourage, persuade, invite. Contoh: He warned us not to go there. | She advised me to study harder. | They reminded him to lock the door.

Verb + -ing / preposition + -ing: Digunakan dengan kata kerja seperti admit, deny, suggest, apologize for, insist on, accuse of. Contoh: He admitted making a mistake. | She apologized for being late. | They denied stealing the money. | He insisted on paying for dinner.

commonTrap.trapTitle: Kesalahan Umum: Menggunakan Pola 'That-clause' untuk Semua Reporting Verbs
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa salah menggunakan pola 'that-clause' untuk semua reporting verbs karena terbiasa dengan 'say that' atau 'tell that'. Padahal, setiap reporting verb memiliki pola gramatikal khusus yang berbeda. Misalnya, 'advise' tidak diikuti langsung dengan 'that-clause' tanpa objek.
commonTrap.wrong: She advised that I should study harder. (kurang natural) | He apologized that he was late. (salah)
commonTrap.correct: She advised me to study harder. | He apologized for being late.

vocab.meaning: mengakui (sesuatu yang tidak menyenangkan atau memalukan)
vocab.collocation: He admitted making a serious mistake in the report.
The teacher warned us not to copy answers during the exam.
The doctor advised him to get more rest and exercise regularly.
She reminded me to send the email before the deadline.
He apologized for interrupting the meeting without permission.
She refused to sign the contract until she read all the terms.
My neighbour offered to help me carry the heavy boxes upstairs.
They promised to arrive on time for the important presentation.
The suspect denied stealing money from the office safe.
My grandmother insisted on paying for everyone's dinner at the restaurant.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan Tom sedang membicarakan pertemuan tim yang baru saja selesai, di mana beberapa anggota tim membuat komitmen dan pernyataan penting.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Did you hear what Mark said in the meeting? He admitted making that accounting error last month.
lines.translation: Kamu dengar apa yang Mark katakan di rapat? Dia mengakui membuat kesalahan akuntansi bulan lalu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, I was surprised. At least he was honest about it. But did you notice that Jenny refused to take responsibility for the late delivery?
lines.translation: Ya, saya terkejut. Setidaknya dia jujur tentang itu. Tapi apakah kamu perhatikan bahwa Jenny menolak bertanggung jawab atas keterlambatan pengiriman?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: I did. She denied having anything to do with it, even though we all saw the emails. Anyway, the manager warned us not to miss any more deadlines.
lines.translation: Saya perhatikan. Dia menyangkal punya hubungan dengan itu, meskipun kita semua melihat email-emailnya. Bagaimanapun, manajer memperingatkan kita untuk tidak melewatkan tenggat waktu lagi.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: That's true. He also advised us to improve our communication between departments. I think he's right about that.
lines.translation: Benar. Dia juga menasihati kita untuk meningkatkan komunikasi antar departemen. Saya pikir dia benar tentang itu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Definitely. Oh, and David offered to train the new staff members next week. That was kind of him.
lines.translation: Pasti. Oh, dan David menawarkan untuk melatih anggota staf baru minggu depan. Itu baik darinya.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Yes, and he promised to finish the training manual by Friday. I hope he keeps his word this time.
lines.translation: Ya, dan dia berjanji menyelesaikan manual pelatihan pada hari Jumat. Saya harap dia menepati janjinya kali ini.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Me too. Before the meeting ended, the manager reminded everyone to submit their reports by Wednesday.
lines.translation: Saya juga. Sebelum rapat berakhir, manajer mengingatkan semua orang untuk menyerahkan laporan mereka pada hari Rabu.

lines.speaker: Tom
lines.text: Good thing he did. I almost forgot about that. By the way, Lisa apologized for being late to the meeting. She said her train was delayed.
lines.translation: Untung dia melakukannya. Saya hampir lupa tentang itu. Oh ya, Lisa meminta maaf karena terlambat ke rapat. Dia bilang keretanya tertunda.

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang berlatih dengan Mr. Khoirul untuk menggunakan reporting verbs dalam situasi sehari-hari. Mr. Khoirul akan memberikan situasi, dan Anda harus merespons dengan kalimat reported speech yang tepat.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Today we'll practice advanced reporting verbs. Let me give you a situation: Your friend said, 'I'm sorry I forgot your birthday.' How would you report this using an appropriate reporting verb?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My friend apologized for forgetting my birthday.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent! Perfect use of 'apologize for + -ing'. Now, imagine your boss said to you, 'Don't share confidential information with anyone.' How would you report this?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My boss warned me not to share confidential information with anyone.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Very good! You used the pattern 'warn + object + not to-infinitive' correctly. Here's another one: Your colleague said, 'I'll help you with the presentation tomorrow.' What reporting verb fits best here?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: My colleague offered to help me with the presentation tomorrow.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Now try this challenging one: Your teacher said to the class, 'You should review your notes every day.' How would you report this with a more precise verb than 'said'?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Our teacher advised us to review our notes every day.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Outstanding work! You've mastered the key patterns. Remember, choosing the right reporting verb makes your English much more precise and natural. Keep practicing these structures!

quiz.question: The manager ___ us not to leave confidential documents on our desks overnight.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'warned'. Kata kerja 'warn' digunakan untuk memperingatkan seseorang tentang bahaya atau hal yang tidak boleh dilakukan. Polanya adalah 'warn + object + (not) to-infinitive'. Dalam konteks ini, manajer memperingatkan tentang tidak meninggalkan dokumen rahasia.

quiz.question: Sarah ___ for arriving late to the interview because of heavy traffic.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'apologized'. Kata kerja 'apologize' digunakan untuk meminta maaf, dengan pola 'apologize for + -ing'. Sarah meminta maaf karena terlambat, bukan mengakui (admit) atau menyangkal (deny).

quiz.question: The doctor ___ him to reduce his sugar intake and exercise more regularly.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'advised'. Kata kerja 'advise' digunakan untuk memberi nasihat atau saran, dengan pola 'advise + object + to-infinitive'. Dokter memberikan saran kesehatan, bukan mengingatkan (remind) atau menolak (refuse).

quiz.question: The suspect ___ stealing the money from the cash register despite the video evidence.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'denied'. Kata kerja 'deny' digunakan untuk menyangkal atau menolak mengakui sesuatu, dengan pola 'deny + -ing'. Tersangka menyangkal mencuri, meskipun ada bukti. 'Refuse' akan diikuti 'to-infinitive', bukan '-ing'.

quiz.question: My colleague ___ to give me a ride to the airport early in the morning.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban yang benar adalah 'offered'. Kata kerja 'offer' digunakan untuk menawarkan bantuan atau sesuatu secara sukarela, dengan pola 'offer + to-infinitive'. Rekan kerja menawarkan untuk mengantar. 'Insist' memerlukan preposisi 'on' dan '-ing', sedangkan 'admit' tidak cocok dengan konteks menawarkan bantuan.
